text:
erin: Quick heads-up: PR #3510 proposes renaming SDK call sites and doc params (create->send, modelId->model). Need a tiny migration note + tone alignment.
sam: paste the PR link and a concise diff please.
erin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3510 - changes mostly under /sdk and /quickstart. Example change in JS: `await client.create({...})` -> `await client.send({...})`.
jin: For prose, recommend: use intent verbs in sentences ("Generate completions") and SDK verbs in code ("call client.send()"). Keeps intent vs API separate.
carla: I'll add a glossary entry: "send (SDK) - canonical method for requesting text generation; use 'generate' in prose." Also normalizing product-name capitalization: "Redwood Dedicated".
glossary-bot: style-check: found 5 occurrences of "create a completion" and inconsistent casing for "dedicated".
erin: Action: carla updates glossary, jin drafts 2-line migration snippet, sam will hold merge until link-check passes. Aim to merge today.
sam: will re-run link-check after updates.
erin: thanks — adding small PR comment with suggested migration snippet.
